blocks.html: CryptPad supports creating and editing Rich Text documents in real time, directly in your browser. Here is how to create, collaborate on, and discuss a document.

slides.title: Create a document
slides.html: Click + in the dashboard and select Rich Text. A new encrypted document is created.

slides.title: Real-time collaboration
slides.html: Write a document simultaneously with others — everyone sees changes as they happen.

slides.title: Discuss the document
slides.html: You can also discuss the document directly inside the document editing view.

slides.title: Other file formats
slides.html: CryptPad doesn't support real-time browser editing of formats such as .docx, but you can share those files on CryptDrive and edit them locally.
